title: Governance finding
description: The one contract every domain reviewer emits. Everything else about a domain may differ.

rule_id.description: Stable rule id from the domain's knowledge layer, for example SEC-001.

severity.description: Severity declared by the rule. The governor applies the domain's mode on top (advise caps block at warn).

message.description: Why this matters, from the domain's guidance.

evidence.description: What was found. Secrets are redacted.

guidance_url.description: Link to this rule in the domain's guidance.

guidance_version.description: Version of the domain knowledge the finding was explained from.

exemplar_good.description: What good looks like, from the knowledge layer.

owner.description: Team or role that owns the domain.
